posts.title: Brazeau River bridge replaced
posts.description: One of the most popular circuit backpacks in the Canadian Rockies is navigable as of September 2026 thanks to the replacement of the Brazeau River bridge below the outlet to Brazeau Lake . The bridge washed out in the spring of 2022. posts.title: Hiking the Golden Triangle
posts.description: The Golden Triangle has been a popular route for touring motorists for nearly a century. But it’s also one of the best routes for accessing half-day and day hikes as well as several scenic backpacks.
